name: Tokuyama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tokuyama city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter V with two pointed strokes.
history: Flag of the former city of Tokuyama in Yamaguchi Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-21. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 November 1953.

features.role: Tokuyama city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter V with two pointed strokes
